_notice: Unverified candidate records of sexual and reproductive health services with physical locations in Northern Virginia (Arlington, Alexandria, Falls Church, Fairfax County, City of Fairfax, Loudoun, Prince William, Manassas, Manassas Park), compiled by AI-assisted research from official/primary pages and the HHS Office of Population Affairs Title X clinic locator API fetched on 2026-10-12. Services are reported neutrally as each source states them. Every field comes from the cited source_url or a URL named in notes. Confirm with the provider before publishing. Community health center sites may overlap the separate HRSA import (hrsa_nova_sites.json).
method: AI-assisted web research of official/primary sources (curl, UA OpenShelf-research/0.1, >=1.2 s between requests per host, robots.txt checked, blocked hosts logged and not retried); Title X sites from api.reproductivehealthservices.gov/v1/clinics (backend of opa-fpclinicdb.hhs.gov), 40-mile radius around 38.85,-77.30; US Census geocoder (Public_AR_Current) with source-provided coordinates only where Census found no match; points filtered with shapely to NoVA locality polygons (TIGERweb); weekday 0 = Monday; unverified candidates

records.location_name: Alexandria Health Department Main Office - Del Pepper Community Resource Center
records.notes: Listed as a Title X family planning clinic in the HHS OPA clinic locator (opa-fpclinicdb.hhs.gov; record https://api.reproductivehealthservices.gov/v1/clinics/65d1c86a-a563-4c9f-a003-c78ae34b0d6f). The OPA record lists birth control (patch, pill, ring, shot, LAM, female and male condoms, emergency contraception, fertility awareness methods, implants, copper and hormonal IUDs, spermicide), pregnancy testing and counseling, achieving pregnancy and basic infertility services, breast/cervical cancer screening, HPV vaccine, STD testing for chlamydia, gonorrhea, syphilis, hepatitis B/C, and HIV testing. City page: free condoms, lubricant and emergency contraceptive available for pick-up at the main office ('Call ahead to ensure the clinic is open'). What to bring may include insurance cards, picture ID, proof of income and proof of address ('Ask what you should bring when you call').
records.raw_hours_text: Hours: Schedules vary. Call 703.746.4888 for appointments.
records.raw_eligibility_text: AHD welcomes people of all gender identities and sexual orientations. Cost : Sliding fee scale. You will not be turned away based on your ability to pay.

services.description: Sexual Health Care & Family Planning: family planning education and counseling; birth control (pill, IUD, implant, NuvaRing, shot); PrEP (pill only); breast cancer and cervical cancer screenings; STI treatment and DoxyPEP. Same-day appointments available on request for STI testing (no symptoms), pregnancy testing, and emergency contraceptive (Plan B / 'Morning After' Pill).

Pregnancy and postpartum support: the sexual and reproductive health clinic 'provides some services for postpartum care as well as pregnancy testing and family planning.' Separate babycarE home-visiting program for Medicaid-eligible City of Alexandria residents (call 703.746.4988).

eligibility.details: Sliding fee scale. You will not be turned away based on your ability to pay.
Call 703.746.4888 for appointments; ask about same-day appointments for STI testing, pregnancy testing and emergency contraceptive.

services.description: STI clinics: confidential detection, screening and treatment of STIs; HIV and syphilis testing, counseling and education; STI education, information and referral; risk reduction counseling. HIV PrEP available in Prince William Health District (call 703-792-6301).
Family Planning services at both the Manassas and Woodbridge clinics (Women's Health & Teen Wellness Services).

records.notes: Page title on lunerahealth.org: 'Lunera Health (formerly GPW Health Center)'. Located in Prince William County (per locality polygon). Women's Care Team listed at this site. records.raw_eligibility_text: The Center serves Prince William County and the Cities of Manassas and Manassas Park in Northern Virginia. We provide Medical, Pediatric, Dental, OB/GYN and Behavioral Health services to all members of our community, regardless of age, income or insurance status.

services.description: OB/GYN: well women care, prenatal care, post-partum, reproductive health; diagnosing and treating normal and high risk pregnancy complications; pregnancy testing, STI testing, routine or annual examinations; fertility options and contraception. Source: https://lunerahealth.org/service/obstetrics-gynecology/
STI: HIV PrEP (can start same day as STI testing), HIV PEP, STI screening. Source: https://lunerahealth.org/service/sti/ (site-level availability not stated).

eligibility.details: Services to all members of our community, regardless of age, income or insurance status.
